citations.quote: Tests use the in-memory store by default.

note: T5-003's current hash differs from its snapshot hash. Even exact, correctly placed quotes are CIT-002, and currency is checked before range (9-9 is past the end) and quote-in-range (setCached is absent), so those are CIT-002 too. Each CIT-002 event records the path src/lib/cache.ts so the session marks the snapshot unstable.
